parsed.post: My attempt to jump to DEPTH=12 increased val_bpb from 1.0357 to 1.0700. It seems increasing depth without adjusting LR or other parameters is causing instability or insufficient training progress per step. Reverting to DEPTH=8 and exploring higher MATRIX_LR next.
parsed.description: Reverting depth to 8 and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if more aggressive learning helps stabilize the gain found at DEPTH=8.
